title: Softmax and LayerNorm performance on the DE1-SoC
status: Board-measured INT8 timings and output agreement
description: FPGA resources are from the standalone Softmax core and the isolated LayerNorm canvas. Softmax resources exclude packed readback logic. Board timings include HPS launch and polling. Softmax includes output readback; LayerNorm is averaged over 24-token batches with in-place writeback. Top-1 agreement compares predictions with FP32 on 3 validation images; dataset-wide classification accuracy was not measured. Supersedes the earlier comparison and per-image projections. The previous screenshot is retained as a historical artifact and does not show these latest results.
